source_name: НБУ — Розширений пошук, тип 21 "План-графік здійснення заходів із відстеження результативності регуляторних актів"
why_relevant: The back half of the regulatory cycle: scheduled ex-post effectiveness tracking of adopted acts. Signals which rules the NBU is about to re-open, i.e. where the next consultation wave will come from.

source_name: НБУ — Регулювання ринку небанківських фінансових послуг
why_relevant: Since the 'split' handed the non-bank market to the NBU, a large share of consultations (payment institutions, finance companies, insurers, credit unions, leasing) is staged from this section rather than the banking one. Sector=both scope makes it mandatory coverage.

source_name: НБУ — Білі книги та консультаційні документи (White Papers / discussion papers)
why_relevant: The pre-legislative tier: before drafting a postanova the NBU publishes a 'біла книга' or 'консультаційний документ' setting out its intended regulatory concept and invites market feedback. This is 12–24 months of lead time on the eventual binding rule (examples: non-bank leasing regulation, ESG management, AI use in the financial sector).

source_name: НБУ — Регуляторна платформа / регуляторна пісочниця (sandbox)
why_relevant: The NBU's regulatory platform/sandbox is where special operating regimes are trialled before being generalised into rules. Participation calls and outcome reports are a leading indicator of forthcoming payment/fintech regulation, and the section carries its own consultative material.

source_name: new.bank.gov.ua — NBU site rebuild / staging mirror
why_relevant: A parallel 'new' NBU web presence surfaced in search results with the same content paths. Worth tracking because a site migration would break every collector URL in this cell; it is an early warning of the future URL scheme, not a content source in its own right.

source_name: Державна регуляторна служба України (ДРС) — регуляторна політика
why_relevant: The DRS is the national watchdog over regulatory policy and publishes its position on regulators' acts, including the methodology binding the NBU ('Методики проведення аналізу впливу та відстеження результативності регуляторного акта Національного банку України'). It is the independent check on the quality of NBU RIAs and sometimes objects publicly.

source_name: Кабінет Міністрів України — Методика проведення аналізу впливу регуляторного акта НБУ
why_relevant: The binding methodology that dictates what an NBU RIA must contain (problem definition, alternatives, mechanism, expected results, effectiveness indicators, tracking measures). Reference document for parsing and normalising the analiz_*.pdf files — it tells the analyst which fields are always present.

source_name: Верховна Рада — портал законопроєктів (пошук законопроєктів)
why_relevant: NBU sub-legislation is frequently downstream of a Rada bill. Tracking banking/payments bills and their committee stages tells you which NBU consultation is coming and on what statutory deadline. Complements, does not duplicate, the NBU feed.

source_name: zakon.rada.gov.ua — офіційний вебпортал законодавства України
why_relevant: Authoritative registry of the enacted text once a consultation closes. Used to close the loop on a tracked draft: did it become a постанова, when, and how did the final text differ from the draft that was consulted on.

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — Проєкти регуляторних актів для обговорення
why_relevant: Adjacent regulator in the financial perimeter: MoF consultations touch state banks, financial-sector taxation and the payments perimeter, and MoF/NBU drafts often move in tandem. Also maintains a year-scoped list ('Проекти регуляторних актів для обговорення у 2026 р.') that models the forward pipeline.

source_name: LIGA:ZAKON — ips.ligazakon.net / biz.ligazakon.net (регуляторний моніторинг)
source_subtype: commercial legal information system / legal press
why_relevant: Commercial Ukrainian legal-information system that covers NBU drafts editorially and often summarises what a draft changes and by when comments close — useful as a cross-check and for catching consultations that the NBU announced quietly. Editorial layer, so credibility is high but derivative.

source_name: PwC Ukraine — NBU Key Regulatory Updates / Tax and Legal Alert
why_relevant: Monthly English digest of NBU regulatory developments including consultations and comment deadlines. High-value for an English-working analyst as a completeness check against the Ukrainian feed and for interpretation of what a draft means commercially.

source_name: CMS Ukraine — legal updates (NBU draft regulations)
why_relevant: Law-firm commentary that reliably picks up significant NBU drafts (e.g. the open-banking draft regulation) with an English explanation of scope and timing. Useful for triage: if CMS writes it up, the draft is commercially material.

source_name: Sayenko Kharenko — banking & finance regulatory updates
why_relevant: One of the Ukrainian firms with a dedicated banking/payments regulatory practice publishing updates on NBU drafts; second independent law-firm channel so a single firm's editorial gaps do not become collection gaps.

source_name: Незалежна асоціація банків України (НАБУ)
why_relevant: The banking industry association is the organised counterparty in NBU consultations: it coordinates member comments on drafts and publishes positions. Its output reveals which parts of a draft the industry will fight — information absent from the NBU's own materials.

source_name: Interfax-Ukraine (economic wire) — NBU draft coverage
why_relevant: Wire service that reports NBU draft resolutions with their comment deadlines in English within hours of publication (e.g. draft statistical-reporting rules for banks, comments to 1 Sept 2026). Fastest independent confirmation channel and a hedge against bank.gov.ua being unreachable.

source_name: Mind.ua / FinClub / Fintech Insider — українська фінансова преса про проєкти НБУ
why_relevant: Ukrainian financial press that reports NBU consultations in local language, often with reaction from market participants and the comment deadline in the lead paragraph. Provides the industry-reaction dimension the regulator's own page never carries.

source_name: PRAVO.UA — юридичне видання про проєкти НБУ
why_relevant: Ukrainian legal-press outlet that reports NBU draft publications with the comment window explicitly stated (observed: draft Regulation on enforcement measures against non-bank market participants, comments to 1 Nov 2023). Historical archive helps reconstruct past consultation windows the NBU page no longer surfaces.

source_name: Asters — Legal Alerts (press centre)
why_relevant: Largest Ukrainian full-service firm; publishes dated, deadline-explicit client alerts on NBU FX easing, open banking launch and payment-market rules, with parallel Ukrainian versions. Stable, crawlable URL slug pattern /press_center/legal_alerts/<slug>/ makes it easy to diff for new items.

source_name: Sayenko Kharenko — Insights (Інсайти)
why_relevant: Top-tier Ukrainian firm with a dedicated banking & finance practice; Insights hub is the firm's alert/publication feed, fully bilingual (sk.ua/uk and sk.ua/en). Historically first-movers on bank ownership-structure disclosure and NBU prudential rules.

source_name: Avellum — Insights / news feed
why_relevant: Banking & financial institutions is a core Avellum practice; publishes tight, dated notes on NBU Resolution No. 18 amendments and currency-control liberalisation steps, usually naming the resolution number and effective date — exactly the deadline-explicit content this cell needs.

source_name: EY Ukraine — EY Ukraine Alert (Tax & Law)
why_relevant: EY Ukraine's alert hub carries Law/Tax/IFRS categories and publishes NBU currency-liberalisation and financial-sector notes; has date and jurisdiction filters plus a subscription list, and offers Ukrainian navigation alongside English.

source_name: KPMG Ukraine / KPMG Law Ukraine — press releases & insights
why_relevant: KPMG Law Ukraine publishes regulator-specific compliance notes (e.g. NBU criteria for 'significant financial companies', currency-restriction relaxations) with dates of the underlying NBU decisions — a Big-4 bilingual bridge on supervisory-perimeter questions.

source_name: Deloitte Ukraine — Legal perspectives / Legal Digest & Financial Services
why_relevant: Deloitte Ukraine issues a periodic 'Legal Digest' and maintains a financial-services industry page; useful as a fourth Big-4 cross-check, though its cadence on banking/payments looks thinner and less deadline-explicit than PwC's NBU digest.

source_name: Kinstellar — News & Insights, Ukraine banking/finance
why_relevant: Kinstellar produced full bilingual PDF newsletters on the Law on Payment Services (separate UKR and ENG editions) plus ongoing FX-liberalisation insights. The paired uk/en PDFs are an unusually clean terminology bridge for building a payments glossary.

source_name: Wolf Theiss — Insights (Ukraine banking/FX)
why_relevant: CEE regional firm covering Ukraine currency-control easing; adds a second independent international read on the same NBU resolutions, useful for triangulating effective dates and scope where firms disagree.

source_name: Baker McKenzie — Global Financial Services Regulatory Guide, Ukraine chapter
why_relevant: A maintained, question-structured reference on Ukrainian licensing/authorisation ('what is the process for becoming authorized') rather than a news feed — the right source for baseline regulatory-perimeter facts against which new alerts are diffed. Kyiv office regulatory team (incl. financial monitoring, currency, capital controls) backs it.

source_name: Baker McKenzie — Insight / Newsroom (Ukraine)
why_relevant: Baker McKenzie Kyiv has historically issued named 'Legal Alerts' on Ukrainian payment-systems law and e-money; the global insight feed is where those surface. Coverage is episodic rather than periodic, so pair it with a syndication watch.
